articles.summary: Jerusalem, July 15, 2026 – Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. (Nasdaq: DRTS, DRTSW) (“Alpha Tau”), the developer of the innovative alpha-radiation cancer therapy Alpha DaRT®, today announced the successful treatment of the first patient in the ADMIRE (Alpha DaRT Management for Immunocompromised patients with REcurrent cSCC) study – a clinical trial evaluating intratumoral Alpha DaRT for […]
articles.title: Alpha Tau Successfully Treats First Immunocompromised Patient with Recurrent Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma in its ADMIRE Study at Banner MD Anderson Cancer Center
